administrator_login.description: (Optional) The administrator login name. Required unless azuread_authentication_only is true.
administrator_login.title: Administrator login

administrator_login_password.description: (Optional) The password associated with the administrator_login. Never typed here: give a reference such as var.db_password.
administrator_login_password.title: Administrator login password

azuread_administrator.description: (Optional) Microsoft Entra administrator configuration. Leave null to skip.
azuread_administrator.title: Azuread administrator

identity_ids.description: (Optional) A list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs. Used when identity_type includes UserAssigned.
identity_ids.title: Identity ids

identity_type.description: (Optional) The type of Managed Identity: SystemAssigned, UserAssigned or 'SystemAssigned, UserAssigned'. Leave null for no identity.
identity_type.title: Identity type

minimum_tls_version.description: (Optional) The minimum TLS version. Valid values are 1.0, 1.1, 1.2 and Disabled.
minimum_tls_version.title: Minimum tls version

name.description: (Required) The name of the SQL Server (globally unique). Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
name.title: Name

public_network_access_enabled.description: (Optional) Whether public network access is allowed for this server.
public_network_access_enabled.title: Public network access enabled

resource_group_name.description: (Required) The name of the resource group in which to create the resource. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
resource_group_name.title: Resource group name

server_version.description: (Optional) The version for the SQL Server. Valid values are 2.0 (v11 server) and 12.0 (v12 server).
server_version.title: Server version

tags.description: (Optional) A mapping of tags to assign to the resource.
tags.title: Tags
